description: You are about 10 feet above the ground nestled among some large branches. The nearest branch above you is above your reach. A bird's nest is tangled around a branch here. In the nest is a large egg encrusted with precious jewels and inlaid with  gold, apparently scavenged somewhere by a childless songbird.
title: Up a Tree

description: This is a small beach on the Frigid River below the Falls. A rainbow  crosses over the falls to the east and a path leads to the southwest.
title: End of Rainbow

description: This room is full of discarded bags, which crumble at your touch. There  is an exit down a staircase.
title: Thief's Den

description: This is a drafty room at the bottom of a long shaft. To the south is a  passageway and to the east a very narrow crack. In the shaft can be seen  a heavy iron chain.
title: Drafty Room

description: This is a small chamber, which appears to have been part of a coal mine. There are openings to the north and east, and a steep metal slide twisting  downward.
title: Slide Room

description: You have come to a dead end in the maze.
title: Dead End

description: This appears to have been an artist's studio. The walls and floors are  splattered with paint. At the west end of the room is an open door. A  narrow chimney leads up from a fireplace; although you might be able to  get up it, it seems unlikely you could get back down.
title: Studio

description: This is a long east-west passage which is cluttered with broken timbers.  At the east end of the room, a rickety ladder leads through an opening in  the roof. A strong draft comes from the west where the room narrows  considerably.
title: Timber Room

description: This is a small room with passages to the east and south and a forbidding hole leading west. Bloodstains and deep scratches mar the walls.
title: The Troll Room

description: This is a circular stone room with passages in all directions, although  several have been blocked by cave-ins.
title: Round Room

description: This was maintenance room for Flood Control Dam #3. On the wall is an  important-looking button. The west wall contains a door.
title: Maintenance Room

description: You are east of a massive stone tomb. Through an open door you see  darkness within.
title: Stone Barrow

description: This is a former Egyptian tomb. There is an ascending staircase to the west.
title: Egyptian Room

description: You are at the base of the dam, on a bank of the river Frigid.
title: Dam Base

description: You have entered the Land of the Living Dead. You can hear the sounds of thousands of lost souls weeping and moaning. A passage exits to the north.
title: Land of the Dead

description: This room smells strongly of coal gas. Tunnels lead south and east.
title: Gas Room
